name: thewindpower-windfarms
title: Global wind farm table (thewindpower.net, licensed)
description: The Wind Power's worldwide wind-farm table from the subscription wind-energy database, release 2025-07-08: one row per wind farm with location, commissioning date, installed capacity, turbine model and count, developer and operator. Used in ICE-2 for validating simulated capacity factors against the real fleet.

ethos:upstream.note: thewindpower.net is live and still sells this data (checked 2026-09-07), so it is obtainable -- by buying a subscription, which is per-location and is why this dataset is restricted and never mirrored. "on-request" here means commercially, not by asking a helpdesk.

ethos:restriction: Licensed from The Wind Power (thewindpower.net) under an ICE-2 database subscription. Redistribution is prohibited: the products must not be communicated outside the licensed location, though studies based on them may be published as long as they contain no raw data from the products. Wind-farm coordinates are raw data -- publishing a map of them is redistribution, not a derived study. ICE-2 members on the institute HPC only; contact the RESKit maintainers.
